test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A person increases his speed by 40%. By doing so, he reaches his office 9 minutes before the usual time. How much time (in minutes) does he take usually to go to his office?
solution:
**Given:**

A person increases his speed by 40%

Time = 9 min

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

A person increases his speed by 40%

⇒ 140x/100x

⇒ 7x/5x

The ratio of the speed of man = 5x : 7x

The ratio of time of man = 7x : 5x [speed is inversely proportional to time]

Now,

The difference between the time of man = (7x – 5x) = 2x

According to the question

He reaches his office 9 minutes before the usual time

⇒ 2x = 9

⇒ x = 9/2

Time taken by him to reach office = 7x = (7 × 9/2)

⇒ 63/2

⇒ 311over2

**∴ The required time is 311over2**
